stops.note: a compound literally meaning 'horse-whale', naming the tusked Arctic mammal
the Norse compound was folk-etymologically inverted and reshaped under influence of Dutch 'walvis' (whale) and 'ros' (horse)
borrowed directly from Dutch sailors and traders in the Arctic fur trade
stops.meaning: large Arctic marine mammal with tusks

current_meaning: a large Arctic marine mammal with tusks and whiskers
